자동차.x: There are lots of cars on the road, so traffic is jammed.

이-가.forms: 이 after a consonant (책이) · 가 after a vowel (친구가) · 나/저/누구 + 가 → 내가/제가/누가
이-가.x: There are many students in the classroom.
이-가.e: 이 after a consonant (책이), 가 after a vowel (친구가).
이-가.t: Watch the special forms: 나 + 가 = 내가, 저 + 가 = 제가, 누구 + 가 = 누가.

와-과.forms: 과 after a consonant (빵과 우유) · 와 after a vowel (우유와 빵)
와-과.e: 와 after a vowel (커피와), 과 after a consonant (빵과).
와-과.t: 와/과 is more formal or written; in conversation 하고 or (이)랑 are more common.

여행사.ex: 여행사에서 비행기 표와 호텔을 같이 예약했어요.
여행사.x: I booked my plane ticket and hotel together through a travel agency.

감독.ex: 그 영화 감독은 상을 많이 받았어요.
감독.x: That film director has won many awards.
감독.t: In sports, 감독 is the head coach or manager; 코치 is an assistant coach.

사업가.ex: 그는 젊은 나이에 성공한 사업가가 되었어요.
사업가.x: He became a successful businessman at a young age.
사업가.e: -가 = person skilled in a field: 사업가, 작가, 전문가.

저축.ex: 미래를 위해 매달 조금씩 저축을 해요.
저축.x: I save a little every month for the future.

예상하다.m: to expect, to predict, to anticipate
예상하다.x: I expected this exam to be difficult.

곧바로.x: I went straight home right after class.

사직.x: He decided to resign because of health problems.
사직.t: 사직 is formal; in conversation people say 회사를 그만두다.

고통.ex: 그는 오랫동안 병 때문에 고통을 받았어요.
고통.x: He suffered from illness for a long time.

전학.ex: 아버지 회사 때문에 서울로 전학을 갔어요.
전학.x: I transferred to a school in Seoul because of my dad's job.
전학.t: Common patterns are 전학을 가다 (move away) and 전학을 오다 (arrive as a transfer).

시집.x: I bought a book of poems by my favorite poet at the bookstore.
시집.t: Don't confuse it with the other 시집 in 시집가다, 'a woman gets married (joins her husband's family)'.

부정.ex: 그 배우는 기자들 앞에서 소문을 강하게 부정했어요.
부정.x: The actor strongly denied the rumor in front of reporters.
부정.t: A different word, also spelled 부정, means 'injustice, cheating', as in 부정행위 'cheating on a test'.

변덕.x: The weather has been really fickle lately.
변덕.t: Common collocations: 변덕이 심하다 (to be very fickle) and 변덕을 부리다 (to act on a whim).

달갑다.ex: 갑자기 생긴 일이 별로 달갑지 않았어요.
달갑다.x: The sudden task wasn't very welcome.
달갑다.e: Probably linked to 달다 'sweet' — something sweet to accept.
달갑다.t: Almost always negative: 달갑지 않다 or 달갑지 않은 손님 (an unwelcome guest).

기가 죽다.forms: 기가 죽어요 · 기가 죽었어요 · 기를 죽이다 (to discourage someone)
기가 죽다.m: to lose heart, to feel discouraged, to be intimidated
기가 죽다.ex: 동생이 시험을 망쳐서 기가 많이 죽었어요.
기가 죽다.x: My younger sibling bombed the test and is really down.
rel: to cheer up, to feel free

발등에 불이 떨어지다.forms: 발등에 불이 떨어졌어요 · 발등에 불이 떨어져서 · 발등에 불 떨어진 사람
발등에 불이 떨어지다.m: to be under pressing pressure, to have a deadline looming (lit. fire falls on the top of one's foot)
발등에 불이 떨어지다.x: The exam is tomorrow, so I'm in a real rush now.
발등에 불이 떨어지다.e: A burning ember lands right on your foot: the trouble is on you and can't be ignored any longer.
발등에 불이 떨어지다.t: Pronounced [발뜽에 부리 떠러지다]. Everyday and casual; typical for deadlines, exams and last-minute panic.
rel: to be right around the corner

사상.ex: 그의 사상은 많은 젊은이들에게 영향을 주었습니다.
사상.x: His ideas influenced many young people.
사상.t: Homonym: 사상 (史上) means 'in history', as in 사상 최대 (the biggest ever).

불경.x: The monk is reading a sutra in the main hall.
불경.t: Its homonym 불경 means 'irreverence', as in 불경스럽다 'to be disrespectful'.

해방.x: Exams are finally over, and I feel free.
해방.t: 해방 is general (even freedom from exams); 광복 refers specifically to Korea's 1945 liberation.

하청.ex: 대기업은 생산의 일부를 하청 업체에 맡깁니다.
하청.x: Large companies hand part of their production to subcontractors.
하청.e: Literally 'request passed down' to a lower company.
하청.t: Often carries a sense of hierarchy; officially 협력 업체 'partner company' is the softer term.

지목하다.m: to point to, to single out, to name (as a suspect or cause)
지목하다.ex: 경찰은 그 남자를 유력한 용의자로 지목했습니다.
지목하다.x: The police named the man as the prime suspect.
지목하다.e: Literally 'point with finger and eye' — singling someone out.
지목하다.t: Pattern: N을 N(으)로 지목하다, often assigning blame: 원인으로 지목하다.

파생되다.x: New problems arose from that policy.
파생되다.t: Grammar term: 파생어 is a derived word, like 먹이 'feed' from 먹다.

연동되다.m: to be linked, to move in tandem, to sync
연동되다.x: This app syncs with a smartwatch.
연동되다.t: Used for devices syncing and for figures that track each other, like 금리와 연동된 대출.

위장하다.m: to disguise, to camouflage, to pose as
위장하다.ex: 범인은 택배 기사로 위장해서 건물에 들어갔어요.
위장하다.x: The criminal got into the building disguised as a delivery driver.
위장하다.t: Not the same as 위장 (胃腸) 'stomach and intestines' — context tells them apart.

긴박하다.x: The accident scene was an extremely tense situation.

일확천금.m: a fortune made overnight, easy money
일확천금.ex: 일확천금을 꿈꾸며 복권을 사는 사람이 많아요.
일확천금.x: Many people buy lottery tickets dreaming of striking it rich overnight.
일확천금.e: Literally 'one grab, a thousand pieces of gold'.

금상첨화.m: icing on the cake; one good thing on top of another
금상첨화.x: The food is delicious and it's cheap too—that's the icing on the cake.
금상첨화.e: Literally 'adding flowers on top of silk brocade.'
금상첨화.t: Its opposite is 설상가상 'frost on snow,' meaning one misfortune piled on another.

경착륙.x: Experts warned that the economy could have a hard landing.
경착륙.e: Literally 'hard touchdown', borrowed from aviation like the English term.

근성.ex: 그 선수는 끝까지 포기하지 않는 근성으로 유명해요.
근성.x: That player is famous for his grit, never giving up.
근성.t: Positive alone (grit), but negative in compounds like 노예 근성 'servile mentality'.

가슴이 철렁하다.m: one's heart sinks, to be startled (by sudden fear or shock)
가슴이 철렁하다.ex: 아이가 넘어지는 걸 보고 가슴이 철렁했어요.
가슴이 철렁하다.x: My heart sank when I saw my child fall.
가슴이 철렁하다.e: 철렁 imitates a sudden heavy jolt, like water sloshing: the heart seems to drop.
가슴이 철렁하다.t: Usually past tense, for a sudden scare: a late-night phone call, a near accident. Variant: 가슴이 철렁 내려앉다.

환청.ex: 밤새 잠을 못 자서 환청이 들리는 것 같아요.
환청.x: I haven't slept all night, so I think I'm hearing things.
환청.t: Used with 들리다: 환청이 들리다 (to hear voices); jokingly said when you think you misheard.

안절부절못하다.m: to be on pins and needles, unable to keep still from anxiety
안절부절못하다.ex: 합격자 발표를 기다리면서 하루 종일 안절부절못했어요.
안절부절못하다.x: I was on pins and needles all day waiting for the list of who passed.
안절부절못하다.e: 안절부절 'fidgeting' + 못하다 'cannot': literally can't settle down.
안절부절못하다.t: Standard form is 안절부절못하다, not 안절부절하다; pronounced [안절부절모타다].

유병률.x: The prevalence of high blood pressure was high among the elderly.
유병률.t: 유병률 counts everyone who has the disease now; 발병률 counts only new cases.

판독.m: reading, interpretation (of scans or test results)
판독.ex: 영상 판독 결과는 다음 주에 나옵니다.
판독.x: The results of the image reading will come out next week.

갈등구조.ex: 이 소설의 갈등구조는 아버지와 아들 사이에서 시작돼요.
갈등구조.x: The conflict structure of this novel begins between a father and son.
갈등구조.e: Literally 'conflict structure'; 갈등 comes from tangled arrowroot and wisteria vines.
갈등구조.t: Pronounced [갈뜽구조]; the ㄷ after ㄹ is tensed.

변곡점.ex: 이 사건은 한국 역사의 중요한 변곡점이 되었습니다.
변곡점.x: This event became an important turning point in Korean history.
